comments.body:
September 30 trace: the shared asset-reference normalizer lowercases the entire URL before separating the hostname from the path. Publish asset validation and the preview resource-URL builder both call it.

With the Cedarmill reference and the same authorization context, the current normalizer produces `/assets/autumn/range.webp` and lookup misses. In a local experiment, lowercasing only the hostname and preserving the path finds `/assets/Autumn/Range.webp`. The asset was not uploaded again or renamed. The all-lowercase control resolves with either version.

This locates the mutation before object lookup. The experiment is local. Both callers still need integration checks before a release.

Mateo owns the normalizer change and the checks for both callers from here. Ren will retain the transport captures. Keep the existing authorization checks in place. A local lookup result is not release readiness or customer verification.

issues.description:
Cedarmill Commerce's Research Agencies Guide stopped at asset validation at 21:03:36 UTC on September 30 with ASSET_REFERENCE_MISSING. The [recorded publish failure](https://posthog.pagemantle.com/project/PH_PROD/events/ph_5b6aba7f3f3b8d108f0abf13) identifies the affected site and attempt.

The September 30 trace retained `/assets/Autumn/Range.webp` in the saved reference, but validation looked up `/assets/autumn/range.webp`. Lookup with the original path found the referenced file.

Preserve path case during asset-reference normalization. Check the shared code's callers with a case-sensitive reference and an all-lowercase control. Keep authorization unchanged and retain the saved reference beside the lookup result.

Mateo owns the implementation work after the transport investigation. No deployed repair or customer verification is recorded.
issues.title: Preserve case in asset reference normalization
